alt: Uber Support chat log exposing the closed-ticket automated black hole.
summary: The concluding segment of an Uber support ticket showing the chat being transferred to a specialized team, followed by automated messages from agents Jose and Gabriela closing the ticket without action due to the passage of 14 and 15 days.
full_text: Conversation. Kat 3 months ago. By the way, transferring our chat will automatically end our conversation, that way our specialized team will be notified... Chat transferred. This conversation has been sent to another team. An agent will do their best to respond within 6 to 12 hours. Uber 3 months ago. Thank you for your patience. I understand you reached out more than 14 days ago, and this ticket will now be closed... Jose 2 months ago. Thank you for your patience. I understand you reached out more than 15 days ago, and this ticket will now be closed... Gabriela 2 months ago.
